title: SyncX
tagline: Connect with your audience and grow your business seamlessly
description:
SyncX is a tool that enables you to connect with your audience through 1:1 sessions - to share your knowledge and monetize your time better. It's designed for people making an impact. Just create your personal link, add your services, availability, and charges; and share your link with your followers. Your followers can now book a call to connect with you. Using SyncX, turn your passion and knowledge into a thriving business. Help your audience succeed in life. Build your marketplace on SyncX with cool features like:

- Create your SyncX page in a flash - Simple & elegant UI to register your profile
- Offer services that you want - Add your services and sell them with ZERO fees
- Creators can earn more on SyncX - Secure calls and get money for every second you spend
- 1:1 calls through Huddle01 - Seamless call experience over a secure infrastructure
- SyncX stores your data on a decentralized database powered by ZKP - Polybase
- Easy profile link to remember - ENS saves you from a long URL with sharing in a fraction of seconds
- Get all updates in your inbox - SyncX will send you booking emails

Create your own marketplace hassle-free with SyncX. We provide you with everything you need to kickstart your business. No need to worry about the technical details – we've got you covered. Start your side hustle today and turn your ideas into reality.
how_its_made: SyncX uses @Huddle01 SDKs to provide the core feature of secure 1:1 calls. We use the @connectkit SDK, viem, and wagmi behind the scenes for user interaction with SyncX features. We designed every asset in Figma and wired those to the UI. We built this sleek UI using Next.js 13, Tailwind CSS, and React components. We easily connected all those services with user profile and bookings using a decentralized database powered by zero-knowledge proofs. SyncX relies entirely on @Polybase to store, sync, fetch, and query the data for services. There is no need to remember a long profile URL because the @ENS resolver will fetch the address from the domain. Users will get paid for every second they spend on a call - that streaming flow of money is implemented using @Superfluid. Also, We used Web3.storage SDK to store profile images.
